cancelled_withdrawal_amount.meaning: _cancelledWithdrawalAmount recorded on cancelWithdrawal, the HYPE value to be re-delegated
cancelled_withdrawal_amount.checkpoint: before redelegateWithdrawnHYPE reads and resets it

caller_has_manager_role.meaning: the caller of redelegateWithdrawnHYPE holds MANAGER_ROLE privileges

redelegated_amount.meaning: amount actually re-delegated via _distributeStake SpotDeposit (truncatedAmount = amount / 1e10 * 1e10)

stranded_hype.meaning: HYPE permanently stranded in the StakingManager contract, outside totalStaked/hypeBuffer accounting and not returnable to users

assumptions: The remainder amount % 1e10 is the portion of _cancelledWithdrawalAmount not included in truncatedAmount sent to L1.
Stranded HYPE is measured in the same HYPE-wei unit as _cancelledWithdrawalAmount.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether stranded HYPE sits in ETH balance or an L1 account; the storage location of the stranded value is unspecified.
Permanence of stranding is asserted as potential, not demonstrated; the conservation relation treats any nonzero stranded_hype as the violation.

limitations: Conservation is stated at the amount level: re-delegated amount plus stranded amount should equal the cancelled withdrawal amount; the report gives no concrete numeric value.
Per-call loss is bounded as less than 1e10 wei (less than 1e-8 HYPE); the accumulated stranded_hype is the sum over calls and is left symbolic.
